prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: highly detailed architectural/game level design presentation drawing, landscape 3:2, large readable high resolution. Reference image is the SELECTED art direction: extravagant theatrical amusement park, RED drapery, EMERALD structures, golden YELLOW bulbs, sunburst arch, central fountain. Create a CONCRETE 3D IMPLEMENTATION MASTERPLAN SHEET, not another eye-level beauty shot. Main panel takes 75%: genuine orthographic overhead top-down furnished site plan, no perspective foreshortening, north at top. Site is 78m wide and 80m long, coordinates x=-39..39, z=-60..20 with north negative z. Relative placement MUST be: 01 cabin/arrival deck SOUTH bottom centered x0,z13; 02 Captain Hook pirate ship just north of cabin x3,z0; 03 grand theatrical entry arch centered x0,z-10; 04 round fountain plaza center x0,z-26; 05 Ferris wheel WEST middle x-21,z-28; 06 carousel EAST middle x21,z-27; 07 mirror maze NORTHWEST x-22,z-48; 08 teacups NORTHEAST x20,z-48. Only ONE of each ride. All are recognizable detailed 3D-designed objects viewed from above, with red/green/gold materials. Wide continuous 8m north-south main promenade, fork into 4m curved paths around 7.6m-diameter central fountain and connect ALL five ride districts, visible access gaps in ornate railings, no dead end at fountain. Mark pedestrian routes with fine teal dashed arrows, show five small control consoles and five golden clue plinths on path edges. Four small HOLLOW pale-gold E markers at potential exit sites (only candidate locations, NOT four active gates). Dense deliberate dressing: red flower beds, benches, golden lamps spaced along path, striped kiosks near arch, strings of bulbs as thin lines overhead, green railings, all outside walking lanes. Main plan must have numbered circular callouts 01-08, north arrow, accurate dimension lines labeled '78 m', '80 m', '8 m', '4 m'. Right sidebar three SMALL supporting views: entrance-to-plaza player view; side elevation of wheel with '18 m'; route strip showing cabin -> ship -> arch -> plaza -> districts. Include clean small palette swatches red/gold/emerald. Typography minimal and well-spaced, English labels only, title 'NEVERLAND / GRAND CARNIVAL', secondary 'LEVEL DESIGN · PLAN 01'. Warm ivory drawing-paper background, fine graphite and gold linework, polished colored architectural illustration with convincing geometry. Avoid visual clutter, excessive decorative text, arbitrary castles, duplicated rides, Christmas motifs, night sky. Clear practical usable layout is more important than beauty-shot atmosphere.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: detailed 3D environment BUILD-UP / EXPLODED VIEW design sheet, large landscape 3:2, high resolution. Reference image is selected design, not edit target: luxurious RED, GOLDEN YELLOW, EMERALD GREEN theatrical amusement park with monumental sunburst arch and fountain. Draw a practical construction breakdown for translating that design into modeled walkable 3D geometry. Warm ivory technical presentation board. LEFT HALF: a large clearly readable exploded axonometric of the GRAND THEATRICAL ARCH, components vertically separated with dotted alignment lines and small numbered callouts: ground foundations and two emerald column bases; tapered fluted green towers with gold corner trim; structural arch leaving a CLEAR 8m-wide pedestrian opening; curved layered deep-red fabric swags; gold sunburst crown and finials; individual warm glowing bulb strings attached to molding; red/green pennant cables. Label clean dimensions '20 m SPAN', '12 m HEIGHT', '8 m CLEAR'. Show these same components assembled in a small front elevation below, silhouette human ruler only (no character art), 1.65m eye-level sightline through opening toward fountain. RIGHT HALF arranged as 4 generous nonoverlapping detail panels: A) cutaway of central fountain (7.6m diameter, three basins, 2.8m overall sculptural height, thin animated water jets, gold rim, red/green star mosaic, 4m clear walkway outside flower border); B) Ferris wheel / carousel / pirate ship small front elevations showing recognizable profiles and dimensions 18m / 8m / 9m, red green gold surfaces and lighting lines; C) three modular promenade assets at usable scale: 1.1m ornamental green-and-gold railing with open access, 3.2m warm globe lamp with red banner, 1.8m bench with rose planter, plus striped ticket booth; D) mystery exit sequence as THREE small panels: luminous ground sigil -> gathering gold particles/light columns -> formed emerald-and-gold sealed doorway with red-haired keeper SILHOUETTE in front, gate 3.4m high; no face detail. Include a small material palette with red velvet, painted emerald metal, brushed gold, pale stone, warm bulb glow. Title 'NEVERLAND / GRAND CARNIVAL', secondary 'EXPLODED BUILD-UP · PLAN 02'. Precise fine technical lines, gorgeous rich colored modeled forms, labels English and short, align all view components cleanly, detailed but legible. NOT an eye-level landscape, NOT a flat moodboard, NOT a single beauty render. No arbitrary buildings or castle background.
correction: Corrected wheel diameter to 16m and carousel diameter to 12m; retained heights 18m and 8m; keeper wears emerald uniform/top hat, no cloak.
